title: IFC-LAZY-PAIR: exact coarse cell branching with linear coherent pair functions

claims.statement: For every integer N>=2 and s in Z/NZ put n=ceil(log2 N). IFC-LAZY-PAIR uses the exact configuration specified by its complete evidence. From independent ideal coset copies it recovers the entire shift with unconditional probability at least1-2^-8. Its total sequential charged work is O(n^(43/4)(log2 n)^2 2^((7/6)sqrt n)), including all bit arithmetic, circuit/address generation, gates, copies, attempts, initialization and cleanup. This exact envelope has growth index1/2. All bounds hold jointly on every branch, with absolute constants.

For every integer N>=2 and s in Z/NZ put n=ceil(log2 N). IFC-LAZY-PAIR uses the exact configuration specified by its complete evidence. From independent ideal coset copies it recovers the entire shift with unconditional probability at least1-2^-8. Its peak ordinary classical space is O(n) bits, including inputs, output, controller, staging and all ordinary records. The exact envelope n has growth index0; all basis-state bank records are instead counted as quantum space. All bounds hold jointly on every branch, with absolute constants.

For every integer N>=2 and s in Z/NZ put n=ceil(log2 N). IFC-LAZY-PAIR uses the exact configuration specified by its complete evidence. From independent ideal coset copies it recovers the entire shift with unconditional probability at least1-2^-8. Its peak allocated quantum space is O(n^(-77/2) 2^(sqrt n)) qubits, counting the entire allocated prefix and acquisition register, including tags, metadata, padding and unused capacity. This exact envelope has growth index1/2. All bounds hold jointly on every branch, with absolute constants.

For every integer N>=2 and s in Z/NZ put n=ceil(log2 N). IFC-LAZY-PAIR uses the exact configuration specified by its complete evidence. From independent ideal coset copies it recovers the entire shift with unconditional probability at least1-2^-8. Its total fresh source copies on the main branch is at most20rC_0+K, and on the finite branch at mostN(n+10), hence uniformly O(n^(35/4)2^((7/6)sqrt n)). This counts every failed and discarded acquisition, independently of peak storage. This exact envelope has growth index1/2. All bounds hold jointly on every branch, with absolute constants.

For every integer N>=2 and s in Z/NZ put n=ceil(log2 N). IFC-LAZY-PAIR uses the exact configuration specified by its complete evidence. From independent ideal coset copies it recovers the entire shift with unconditional probability at least1-2^-8. Its guaranteed malformed-copy fraction is epsilon(n)=0 under exactly the independent ideal-copy error_model in the fifth structured object. No positive tolerance or impossibility of robustness is asserted. All bounds hold jointly on every branch, with absolute constants.

structured.error_model: Malformed fraction among acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
